articles.title: Peel police investigate homicide after man dies of stab wounds in Mississauga
articles.summary: A man is dead after a stabbing in Mississauga on Saturday morning, Peel police say. Details on potential suspects is not yet available as the homicide unit investigates the incident.

articles.title: Man dead in early morning stabbing in Mississauga
articles.summary: One man is dead following an early morning stabbing in Mississauga.

articles.title: Lawyers unsure if extra funding can reduce massive caseload at Federal Court
articles.summary: OTTAWA — The recent federal budget included $58 million in additional funding court administration but the Federal Court still doesn't have a clear picture of how it can be used to reduce a massive caseload that has grown rapidly since 2020.

articles.title: Ontario's Bill 140 raises concerns over landfill approvals, groundwater protection in Caledon, Ont.
articles.summary: Ontario's proposed Bill 140 would remove a municipal support requirement for certain large landfills, prompting concerns about groundwater and the time available for Caledon's incoming council to respond.

articles.title: Flight delays may continue at Pearson Airport as U.S. ground stop lifted, NAV Canada says
articles.summary: Flights at Toronto Pearson International Airport may continue to be delayed on Friday night after an order that grounded all planes in the U.S. was lifted, NAV Canada says.

articles.title: Family, police believe missing Ontario teen is in Saskatchewan
articles.summary: On Friday, Saskatchewan RCMP shared a news release on behalf of Durham Regional Police asking for the public's help finding Cairo. The 14-year-old was last seen in Courtice, about an hour outside Toronto, on Sept. 20.

articles.title: 2 workers critically injured in collision on Pickering construction site: police
articles.summary: Two workers are critically injured after being struck by a driver on a construction site in Pickering, police say.

articles.title: Stelco recalling 175 laid-off workers at Hamilton steel plant
articles.summary: Hamilton steelmaker Stelco is recalling its 175 workers that had been laid off earlier this fall.

articles.title: Feds, Ontario offering Stellantis 'aggressive package' to keep Brampton auto plant open
articles.summary: The federal and Ontario governments are mounting a last-ditch effort to save the Stellantis auto plant in Brampton by pitching the company possible survival "scenarios" and offering an "aggressive package" of support to make it happen.

articles.title: Coroner's inquest begins in case of Mississauga man shot by police in 2020
articles.summary: A coroner's inquest into the death of a man shot in the head by police in Mississauga, Ont., is underway on Friday. Jamal Francique, a 28-year-old Black man, was shot during an attempted arrest outside his home on Jan. 7, 2020, and died in hospital days later.

articles.title: Fatal fire at Scarborough home under investigation, chief says
articles.summary: The Office of the Fire Marshall has been notified, while Toronto's fire chief says it's too early to identify the cause of the fire.

articles.title: Construction underway on 2 bridges as part of Highway 413 project: Sarkaria
articles.summary: Construction is now underway on two new bridges to connect drivers to the upcoming Highway 413, a project that aims to reduce congestion in parts of the Greater Toronto Area, Transportation Minister Prabmeet Sarkaria said at a news conference in Brampton Friday.

articles.title: U of T music community celebrates beloved professor Mary Morrison's 100th birthday
articles.summary: Hundreds came together to celebrate the 100th birthday of a beloved music professor at the University of Toronto this week, along with her decades-long career teaching and performing opera.
